reasoning_details.text:
**Estimating Effort for User Stories**

I'm currently analyzing the provided user stories (U1-U8) within the Spring XD/Spring Framework context to develop workdays estimations. My focus is on understanding the technical requirements and dependencies to ensure an accurate effort projection.

**Developing Windows Build Scripts**

I'm focusing on refining the build process for Windows, specifically addressing file separator and pathing issues within the Gradle and Maven scripts. My goal is to ensure seamless native building and testing on that platform.

**Refining Build Scripts and Integrations**

I'm currently refining the Windows build scripts, aiming to establish a robust CI pipeline for builds and tests on that environment. Concurrently, I'm diving into implementing Spark Streaming processors for Spring XD, exploring both Java and Scala approaches, and backporting crucial changes to Spring Integration Kafka for an upcoming GA release upgrade.

**Integrating Kafka and Hadoop Components**

I'm currently focused on the Spring XD Kafka integration, specifically upgrading the dependency to the SI Kafka GA release and thoroughly testing the resulting integration. Concurrently, I'm working on upgrading Spring Hadoop to its GA release, verifying Hadoop integrations, and addressing any API breaking changes while running comprehensive test suites.

technical_and_design_decisions: Use Java 17+ / Java 8 Lambdas as base JVM compatibility where applicable while targetting Spring XD framework components.
Implement Spark Streaming processors supporting both Java (with Lambda expressions) and Scala API variants to demonstrate XD processing capabilities.
Maintain Windows compatibility across Gradle build scripts, batch files, and path handling to ensure native Windows build support.
Provision AWS EC2 Windows Server instances configured with necessary Java, build tools, and test harness to execute automated acceptance tests.
Perform code backports from Spring XD custom Kafka components into Spring Integration Kafka before upgrading dependency pointers to SI Kafka GA.
assumptions: Development work is performed by a single developer familiar with Spring Framework, Spring XD, Spring Integration, Hadoop (SHDP), Spark Streaming, and Kafka.
Target repositories and dependency artifacts (SI Kafka GA, SHDP GA) are accessible in public or standard Maven repositories.
AWS credentials and EC2 infrastructure access are available for provisioning Windows instances for CI/acceptance testing.
Documentation sources (AsciiDoc/DocBook) for the reference guide are integrated into the repository build pipeline.

activities.activity_name: XD 1.0 to 1.1 Migration & Custom Module Support (U1)
activities.activity_description: Create migration guide documentation and verify/test porting of custom user modules from Spring XD 1.0 to 1.1, ensuring compatibility with pipeline changes.
Develop a sample application/job demonstrating Pig script execution within Spring XD, including README guide and unit/integration test harness.
Audit and update build scripts (Gradle/Maven), batch files, and path resolution across the codebase to ensure Spring XD builds natively on Windows.

activities.activity_name: EC2 Windows Acceptance Tests & CI Pipeline Setup (U4)
activities.activity_description: Provision an EC2 Windows AMI, set up test runners and environment dependencies, run full acceptance test suites on Windows, and integrate into the CI build workflow.
Implement Spark Streaming processor components in Spring XD using both Java/Java Lambdas and Scala implementations, complete with integration tests and sample flows.
Update reference documentation configuration and copyright headers in documentation sources to reflect year 2015 and verify PDF build output.

activities.activity_name: Kafka SI Backport and Upgrade to GA (U7)
activities.activity_description: Backport Kafka changes from Spring XD to Spring Integration Kafka (SI Kafka), update Spring XD dependencies to SI Kafka GA release, and resolve integration issues.
Upgrade Spring Hadoop (SHDP) dependencies to the GA release, address any API breaking changes, and execute Hadoop-related test suites.
Perform full regression testing across modified components, verify cross-platform build execution, and validate overall build stability.
